title: Web Hosting Plans Benefit on Inbound Transfer Charges — Domain Registrations Domain Care Credit
content:
**Domain Registrations — hosting benefit card for Domain Care price matches on inbound transfer charges**

The transfer line's hosting credit is one of the Domain Care credits an inbound transfer charge of Domain Registrations earns. It rests on the Web Hosting Plans plan that is set up for the transferred domain, that is a Harborline hosting plan whose primary domain is this domain.

### Clause

The transfer line's hosting credit, one of the charge's Domain Care credits, is USD 3.00 for each year the charge covered where a Harborline hosting plan whose primary domain is this domain has status active and a billing term of 12 months or more, USD 1.50 for each year the charge covered where such a plan has status active and a billing term of 1 month, and nothing otherwise.

### Benefit card

| Web Hosting Plans plan for this domain | Hosting credit |
|---|---|
| Status active, billing term of 12 months or more | USD 3.00 for each year the charge covered |
| Status active, billing term of 1 month | USD 1.50 for each year the charge covered |
| Any other case: no plan has this domain as its primary domain, or the plan is not active | nothing |

The plan's status and billing term are read from the Web Hosting Plans holding whose primary domain is the domain the inbound transfer charge belongs to; a plan set up for a different primary domain does not count, whatever its term.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- An inbound transfer charge covering 1 year, the domain being the primary domain of an active Harborline Pro plan on a 24-month term: the hosting credit is USD 3.00.
- The same charge, the plan being active on a 1-month term: USD 1.50.
- The same charge, the plan for this domain being suspended or cancelled: nothing.
- A hypothetical charge covering 2 years with an active 12-month plan: USD 3.00 for each of the 2 years, USD 6.00 in all.
